authorship: Codex-assisted demonstration; no local LLM inference generated this dataset or solution.
outcome: Stochastically simulated analyst decision to escalate an alert within a 30-day label window; not verified fraud.

generator.features: Independent standard-normal latent activity and latent risk create correlated synthetic past-behavior snapshots. All equations, rounding and bounds are in generate_data.py. Each customer appears exactly once.
generator.label_formula: logit = -2.35 + 0.70*log(amount_to_median) + 0.45*log1p(transfers_24h/5) + 0.35*log1p(unique_recipients_7d/6) + 1.40*(new_recipient_ratio_7d-0.2) + 0.70*(cross_border_ratio_30d-0.12) + 1.20*(night_transfer_ratio_7d-0.15) - 0.25*log1p(account_age_days/365) + 0.30*prior_alerts_180d + 0.80*I(amount_to_median>2 and new_recipient_ratio_7d>0.35) + 0.40*max(log(inflow_outflow_ratio_7d),0) + Normal(0,0.75); y ~ Bernoulli(sigmoid(logit))
generator.stochastic_labels: Outcome noise and Bernoulli sampling use distinct RNG streams; features do not deterministically identify labels.

feature_definitions.amount_log: Natural log(1 + alert transaction amount in synthetic currency units).
feature_definitions.amount_to_median: Alert amount divided by the customer's historical median amount.
feature_definitions.transfers_24h: Count of prior transfers over 24 hours.
feature_definitions.unique_recipients_7d: Count of unique prior recipients over 7 days.
feature_definitions.cross_border_ratio_30d: Share of prior transfers that were cross-border over 30 days.
feature_definitions.new_recipient_ratio_7d: Share of prior transfers to newly observed recipients over 7 days.
feature_definitions.night_transfer_ratio_7d: Share of prior transfers during night hours over 7 days.
feature_definitions.account_age_days: Account age at the alert time.
feature_definitions.prior_alerts_180d: Count of alerts known before the current alert over 180 days; not future outcomes.
feature_definitions.inflow_outflow_ratio_7d: Prior incoming amount divided by prior outgoing amount over 7 days.

limitations: No real customers, transactions, analyst decisions or production validation are represented.
Features are synthetic snapshots; their lookback semantics are stipulated rather than reconstructed from an event ledger.
Days are stationary draws. Chronological evaluation demonstrates time discipline but does not demonstrate robustness to real-world drift.
All customers are unique; repeated-customer dependence and real operational feedback are absent.
The known outcome formula makes this an educational benchmark; its metrics cannot establish deployment suitability or fraud detection quality.
Thirty-day maturity is assumed fixed. Production label delay, censoring, privacy, fairness and analyst selection bias require separate review.
Maturity-gap rows are excluded from all model fitting, selection, threshold tuning and final test evaluation.
